tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Cambium Networks ePMP™ Force 400 Series

Cambium Networks introduces the ePMP Force 400C point-to-point solution delivering up to 1 Gbps throughput at a breakthrough price point based on the latest 802.11ax standards.

Cambium Networks introduces the ePMP Force 400C point-to-point solutions delivering up to 1 Gbps throughput at a breakthrough price point based on the latest 802.11ax standards. The Force 400 Series is the ideal solution for service providers looking to deliver high-capacity access services to Enterprise and residential customers. It also serves as a low-cost backhaul for MicroPOPs and outdoor Wi-Fi access points that require lots of capacity at moderate range without the overhead of licensed microwave, with an integrated SFP port.

For even longer-range applications, the Force 400C is a connectorized option with two RP-SMA RF interfaces for use with larger parabolic dishes or horn antennas. 

Leveraging the latest technology from the 802.11ax standard and Cambium’s proprietary ePTP mode, the Force 400C delivers high spectral efficiency with features such as 1024QAM, 80 MHz channels, a highly efficient frame structure, and the proven ePTP air interface. The Force 400 Series delivers Gbps performance with less than 5 ms latency.


Key Features:

  • Frequency Range: 4910 – 6135 MHz

  • Up to 1 Gbps+ aggregate throughput

  • Connectorized design (supports external dish antennas)

  • Based on 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6) standard

  • 2x2 MIMO with advanced modulation up to 1024QAM

  • TDD synchronization with GPS support

  • Low latency, high spectral efficiency

  • Rugged outdoor IP67-rated enclosure

  • Ideal for long-distance, noise-resistant wireless links

Link Distance:

  • Maximum Distance: Up to 100+ km (with high-gain external antennas and clear LOS)

  • Typical Performance: 10–60 km for stable high-throughput performance


Ideal Use Cases:

  • Wireless ISP long-haul backhaul

  • CCTV and security networks

  • Rural broadband connectivity

  • Fiber extension over wireless
